sourceBinding.authorityRule: The Production Claim remains bound to the exact historical Studio revision. The current Media repository path is a recovery locator and does not rewrite the historical fence or currentize the Claim.

observerScope.purpose: test transformation, provenance, semantic identity, Blob identity, realization and loss boundaries using a real Studio Production

projectionEnvelope.standingRule: An approved Output does not imply that the parent Production is published or closed.

nonVisualSourceByteVariantObservation.method: insert an XML comment into a temporary copy of the exact SVG source and rerender with the same tool/settings
nonVisualSourceByteVariantObservation.scope: This proves byte-identity non-collapse for this renderer/input change; it does not establish universal semantic equivalence of arbitrary SVG variants.

lossDisclosure.pngKind: PNG image data, 1200 x 630, 8-bit/color RGB, non-interlaced
lossDisclosure.claim: The PNG preserves the selected rendered raster realization but does not preserve the SVG element tree, text nodes or vector edit structure as an editable source.
